children: Stock-specific action remained in focus on Dalal Street on September 7, with investors reacting to corporate developments.

Molbio Diagnostics share price shed 2% despite company reported a consolidated profit of ₹58.7 crore, compared with a loss of ₹23.7 crore in the year-ago period, while revenue grew nearly four-fold to ₹408.4 crore from ₹99.7 crore, YoY.

Jayaswal Neco Industries (JNIL) share price added 2% after company clarified that there is no direct relationship between Datasel SRL, Neco Defence Munitions and Jayaswal Neco Industries, except that both entities are owned by the same promoter group. JNIL does not have any transactions with Datasel SRL or Neco Defence Munitions. Any consequences arising therefrom will not have any financial impact on JNIL, as Datasel SRL operates independently.

Shares of Morepen Laboratories rose 3% on successfully completion of first phase of its manufacturing capacity expansion program ahead of the previously indicated timeline. Under this first phase, the company’s installed reactor capacity for API and CDMO has increased from 535 KL to 614 KL.
On the sectoral front, Nifty IT index shed nearly 2%, Nifty Media index declined more than 2%, Nifty Realty index fell 0.7%, while Telecom index added more than 1.5%.
The broader indices were trading mostly unchnaged, with the Nifty Midcap index down 0.2% and the Smallcap index was flat.
However, market breadth on the BSE remained positive, with 1,926 shares advancing, 1,583 declining and 204 unchanged, indicating a positive trend beneath the headline gains.

title: Price Action: Molbio Diagnostics falls 2% despite profitable in Q2; Jayaswal Neco, Morepen Laboratories shares gain
